system.description:
Playful, friendly, and always up for some well-intended mischief, Otterfolk are at home both in water and on land. Although they can be fierce warriors, they typically prefer using their environment to their advantage.

At Home in Water

You have a swim Speed as long as you are wearing armor no heavier than leather. [A — disable the rule manually while wearing heavier armor]

When Field Resting in water, you regain additional HP equal to your level. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by The Rotten Pixie.
